verdict.rationale: Digits documents AI-native auto-categorization (AGL trained on 170M+ transactions, 95%+ auto-booking) and 'transaction flagging & smart reviews' suggesting a learning/correction loop, but there is no explicit documentation of a feedback mechanism where founder corrections are captured and used to retrain or adjust future suggestions. missing for 10: explicit description of a correction-feedback loop showing suggestions improve from user edits, independent/hands-on verification of accuracy improving over time, and details on how manual overrides are ingested by the categorization model.
